diagnosis: The get_subscription_entity dependency fetches the subscription record by stripe_subscription_id from the route path parameter. Neither the dependency nor the endpoint handler verifies that subscription.customer_id matches user.customer_id. Any authenticated user can disable automatic renewal on another customer's subscription by supplying their subscription ID.
exploit_request:
POST /billing/subscriptions/sub_live_94821a/cancel-renewal HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
